integrity: All six projective degrees are obtained by an exact integer intersection calculation. A standalone verifier recomputes the preliminary intersections and every exceptional-plane correction. No numerical approximation is used.
scientific limitations: The calculation assumes the common resolution and normal-bundle data proved in arXiv:2609.10353. It establishes only the projective multidegree of that fixed Cremona transformation; it does not generalize to other Enriques models or degenerations. Targeted literature searches cannot exclude an unindexed prior computation.
title: Projective multidegree of the Enriques Cremona transformation
